instruction: Create an S3 bucket with server-side encryption
output: echo 'bucket = aws.s3.Bucket("secure", server_side_encryption_configuration=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationArgs(rule=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleArgs(apply_server_side_encryption_by_default=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefaultArgs(sse_algorithm="AES256"))))' > s3-encrypt.py

instruction: Set S3 bucket public access block
output: echo 'block = aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlock("block", bucket=bucket.id, block_public_acls=True, block_public_policy=True, ignore_public_acls=True, restrict_public_buckets=True)' > s3-security.py

instruction: Create an IAM instance profile with roles
output: echo 'profile = aws.iam.InstanceProfile("ec2", role=role.name)' > profile.py

instruction: Create a security group with computed ingress from another SG
output: echo 'sg_app = aws.ec2.SecurityGroup("app", vpc_id=vpc.id, ingress=[aws.ec2.SecurityGroupIngressArgs(from_port=443, to_port=443, protocol="tcp", security_groups=[sg_lb.id])])' > sg-advanced.py

instruction: Create a VPC endpoint for SSM
output: echo 'ssm_endpoint = aws.ec2.VpcEndpoint("ssm", vpc_id=vpc.id, service_name=f"com.amazonaws.{region}.ssm", subnet_ids=private_subnet_ids, security_group_ids=[sg_vpc_endpoint.id])' > vpc-endpoint.py

instruction: Create a transitive gateway attachment
output: echo 'tgw = aws.ec2transitgateway.TransitGateway("main"); attachment = aws.ec2transitgateway.VpcAttachment("attach", subnet_ids=subnet_ids, transit_gateway_id=tgw.id, vpc_id=vpc.id)' > tgw.py

instruction: Mount an EFS filesystem on EC2 user-data
output:
echo 'instance = aws.ec2.Instance("app", user_data=f"#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /mnt/efs
mount -t nfs4 {fs.dns_name}:/ /mnt/efs
echo "{fs.dns_name}:/ /mnt/efs nfs4 defaults,_netdev 0 0" >> /etc/fstab")' > efs-mount.py

instruction: Create a CloudWatch log group with retention
output: echo 'log_group = aws.cloudwatch.LogGroup("app", name="/aws/lambda/my-function", retention_in_days=30)' > logs.py

instruction: Create a CloudWatch log subscription to Lambda
output: echo 'sub = aws.cloudwatch.LogSubscriptionFilter("filter", log_group=log_group.name, destination_arn=fn.arn, filter_pattern="ERROR")' > log-sub.py

instruction: Add a CloudWatch metric filter to log group
output: echo 'filter = aws.cloudwatch.LogMetricFilter("errors", log_group_name=log_group.name, pattern="ERROR", metric_transformation=aws.cloudwatch.LogMetricFilterMetricTransformationArgs(name="ErrorCount", namespace="App", value="1"))' > metric-filter.py

instruction: Set a budget alert in Pulumi
output: echo 'budget = aws.budgets.Budget("monthly", budget_type="COST", limit_amount="500", limit_unit="USD", time_period_start="2025-01-01_00:00", time_unit="MONTHLY", notification=[aws.budgets.BudgetNotificationArgs(comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN", threshold=80, threshold_type="PERCENTAGE", notification_type="ACTUAL", subscriber_email_addresses=["team@example.com"])])' > budget.py

instruction: Output filtered tags in pulumi stack export
output: pulumi stack export --file state.json && jq '.checkpoint.latest.resources[] | select(.type | startswith("aws")) | .urn' state.json

instruction: Find all resources of a specific type in state
output: pulumi stack export | jq '.checkpoint.latest.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:s3/bucket:Bucket")'

instruction: Debug a stack's configuration from exported JSON
output: pulumi stack export | jq '.checkpoint.latest.config'

instruction: Create a Pulumi YAML program with an S3 bucket
output:
echo 'name: infra
runtime: yaml
resources:
  my-bucket:
    type: aws:s3/bucket:Bucket' > Pulumi.yaml

instruction: Add a security group to the Pulumi YAML program
output:
echo '  web-sg:
    type: aws:ec2/securityGroup:SecurityGroup
    properties:
      ingress:
        - protocol: tcp
          fromPort: 80
          toPort: 80
          cidrBlocks: ["0.0.0.0/0"]' > Pulumi.yaml

instruction: Add stack outputs in Pulumi YAML
output:
echo 'outputs:
  bucketName: ${my-bucket.id}' > Pulumi.yaml

instruction: Use Pulumi YAML template function
output:
echo '  config:
    env:
      type: String
      default: prod' > Pulumi.yaml

instruction: Create an EC2 instance in Pulumi YAML
output:
echo '  web:
    type: aws:ec2/instance:Instance
    properties:
      ami: ami-1234
      instanceType: t3.micro' > Pulumi.yaml

instruction: Export a stack output in Pulumi YAML
output:
echo 'outputs:
  publicIp: ${web.publicIp}' >> Pulumi.yaml
